name: blueprint
description: Turn a rough app, feature, or ML model idea into PRD, SPEC, and TASKS docs an AI coding agent can build from.

interface.shortDescription: Write PRD, SPEC, and TASKS before vibe coding
interface.longDescription: Use Blueprint to turn a rough idea into documents an AI coding agent can build from without guessing: a PRD (why and what), a SPEC (how), and TASKS (ordered, verifiable steps). It interviews in plain language, one question at a time, so non-developers can use it, and reviews each document against a checklist.
defaultPrompt: Use Blueprint to turn my app idea into PRD, SPEC, and TASKS docs.
Use Blueprint to plan this model before we write any code.
